evidence_refs.description: Evidence plane evaluation showing missing projection receipt

learning.objective: The learner will understand the projection provenance chain: runtime receipts feed into projections, which feed into surfaces. A missing link at any level invalidates surface trust.
learning.explanation: Projection provenance is the final validation layer. It checks that what a user sees (the surface) matches what the evidence says (the projection). A missing projection receipt means the surface might be displaying stale or incorrect state. This is like a dashboard gauge that is not connected to the actual sensor — the needle moves, but you cannot trust the reading. The absence is diagnosable and classifiable, which is the first step toward repair.

criteria.description: Learner can explain the three-layer projection model: runtime → projection → surface
Learner can identify a missing projection receipt from evidence output
Learner can explain why missing provenance invalidates surface trust without claiming repair authority
